title: JotJSON perf-targets
description: Operationalizable NFR ceilings for the perf measurement suite. Each row maps a perfRowKey (<layer>.<scenario>.<fixture>.<size>) to one or more metric ceilings. `ceiling_ms` accepts negative values (typically -1) as a sentinel for draft-PR placeholders; `scripts/perf/check-no-sentinel-ceilings.mjs` (chained into `npm run lint`) rejects any negative value so sentinels cannot merge to main.
